zero.citation: ECMAScript Number arithmetic; mathematical identities and unit conversions, not behavior coefficients.

one.citation: ECMAScript Number arithmetic; mathematical identities and unit conversions, not behavior coefficients.

two.citation: ECMAScript Number arithmetic; mathematical identities and unit conversions, not behavior coefficients.

negativeOne.citation: ECMAScript Number arithmetic; mathematical identities and unit conversions, not behavior coefficients.

percent.citation: ECMAScript Number arithmetic; mathematical identities and unit conversions, not behavior coefficients.

minorPerDollar.citation: ISO 4217: USD minor unit has two decimal places.

minutesPerHour.citation: SI: one hour is sixty minutes.

millisecondsPerSecond.citation: SI: one second is one thousand milliseconds.

hoursPerDay.citation: Civil calendar: one day contains 24 nominal hours; date arithmetic uses UTC date-only days.

daysPerWeek.citation: Gregorian civil calendar: seven days per week.

monthsPerYear.citation: Gregorian civil calendar: twelve months per year.

isoYearCharacters.citation: ISO 8601 calendar date: four-character year in the supported date range.

isoMonthCharacters.citation: ISO 8601 calendar date: YYYY-MM is seven characters.

seedPlaceHashRadix.citation: Hexadecimal stable identity hash representation; not a behavioral draw.

seedHashDigits.citation: Existing stable-hash representation's leading eight hexadecimal digits used to select among recorded identity options only.

emotionComparisonDigits.citation: Technical floating-point test precision; not a model coefficient.

workingDaysPerWeek.estimatedFrom: Five weekdays out of the civil seven-day week for ordinary full-time job offers; individual work calendars remain a reported gap.
workingDaysPerWeek.citation: BLS American Time Use Survey 2025, Table 1 and news release; https://www.bls.gov/news.release/atus.t01.htm and https://www.bls.gov/news.release/atus.nr0.htm

wageMedianPercentile.citation: The median is the fiftieth percentile; exact wage source remains attached to each job.

annualWorkHours.citation: BLS OEWS technical notes use 2080 hours for annualizing hourly wage estimates; https://www.bls.gov/oes/current/oes_tec.htm

sundayIndex.citation: ECMAScript Date.getUTCDay: Sunday is index zero.

saturdayIndex.citation: ECMAScript Date.getUTCDay: Saturday is index six.

marriageReferenceAge.estimatedFrom: Prototype summarized adult partnership timing from the existing generated-household age bands; never a claim about a real person's wedding date.
marriageReferenceAge.citation: Existing game town-residents household adults; Census historical median first-marriage ages vary by sex and cohort.

censusPlaceGeoidLength.citation: Census place GEOID: two state FIPS digits and five place digits.

populationTestMinimum.citation: Technical population fixture size for complete-household test coverage, not a simulated population-rate parameter.

populationTestIncrement.citation: Technical fixture increment for the full-household admission test, not a behavioral parameter.

daysPerMeanYear.citation: Gregorian leap-year cycle: 146097 days per 400 years.

targetPopulation.citation: 00s PACKAGES, P8 CORE, owner decision October 9, 2026.

yearSecondsBudget.citation: 00s PACKAGES, P8 CORE, owner decision October 9, 2026.

memoryMiBBudget.estimatedFrom: A provisional prototype-process budget of one GiB within the P7 default-heap limit; measured RSS and heap reported separately.
memoryMiBBudget.citation: 00s P7 DIET requires default-heap typecheck memory under four GB. P8 does not specify a numeric memory cap.

traitScale.citation: Existing recorded trait strength scale, src/simulation/traits/act-pulls.ts; adapter checks the source scale before conversion.

workHours.citation: BLS American Time Use Survey 2025, Table 1 and news release; https://www.bls.gov/news.release/atus.t01.htm and https://www.bls.gov/news.release/atus.nr0.htm

restHours.citation: BLS American Time Use Survey 2025, Table 1 and news release; https://www.bls.gov/news.release/atus.t01.htm and https://www.bls.gov/news.release/atus.nr0.htm

socialHours.citation: BLS American Time Use Survey 2025, Table 1 and news release; https://www.bls.gov/news.release/atus.t01.htm and https://www.bls.gov/news.release/atus.nr0.htm

careHours.estimatedFrom: Prototype half-hour bounded family-care offer; not the ATUS population-average duration.
careHours.citation: BLS American Time Use Survey 2025, Table 1 and news release; https://www.bls.gov/news.release/atus.t01.htm and https://www.bls.gov/news.release/atus.nr0.htm

civicHours.estimatedFrom: ATUS organization/civic activity is aggregated across nonparticipants; one hour is a prototype offer duration, not an observed population average.
civicHours.citation: BLS American Time Use Survey 2025, Table 1 and news release; https://www.bls.gov/news.release/atus.t01.htm and https://www.bls.gov/news.release/atus.nr0.htm

stressBaseline.estimatedFrom: Prototype opening baseline on a normalized stress channel. No claim of a US population norm.
stressBaseline.citation: Cohen et al. (1983), Perceived Stress Scale, doi:10.2307/2136404; empirical calibration remains a gap.

moodBaseline.estimatedFrom: Neutral signed prototype affect channel before any recorded event. PANAS uses separate positive and negative channels, so this is an approximation.

moodHalfLifeDays.estimatedFrom: Smooth analytic decay spanning hours to days; prototype estimate pending empirical decay calibration.
moodHalfLifeDays.citation: Kuppens et al. (2010), Feelings change: accounting for individual differences in the temporal dynamics of affect, doi:10.1037/a0020962. Half-lives below are prototype estimates, not estimates reported by this study.

stressHalfLifeDays.estimatedFrom: Persistent stress can outlast transient affect; prototype estimate pending empirical decay calibration.
stressHalfLifeDays.citation: Kuppens et al. (2010), Feelings change: accounting for individual differences in the temporal dynamics of affect, doi:10.1037/a0020962. Half-lives below are prototype estimates, not estimates reported by this study.

needWeight.estimatedFrom: Equal normalized utility of a fully unsatisfied need; explicit prototype assumption, not an empirical coefficient.
needWeight.citation: BLS American Time Use Survey 2025, Table 1 and news release; https://www.bls.gov/news.release/atus.t01.htm and https://www.bls.gov/news.release/atus.nr0.htm

goalWeight.estimatedFrom: Equal normalized utility of an active goal; explicit prototype assumption awaiting documented P9 replay calibration.
goalWeight.citation: 00s PACKAGES, P8 CORE, owner decision October 9, 2026.

driveWeight.estimatedFrom: Equal normalized utility of an event-born drive; explicit prototype assumption awaiting documented P9 replay calibration.
driveWeight.citation: 00s PACKAGES, P8 CORE, owner decision October 9, 2026.

traitWeight.estimatedFrom: One-fifth normalized trait contribution from the existing direction table; magnitude remains uncalibrated.

emotionWeight.estimatedFrom: One-fifth normalized affect contribution; causal magnitude remains uncalibrated.
emotionWeight.citation: Kuppens et al. (2010), Feelings change: accounting for individual differences in the temporal dynamics of affect, doi:10.1037/a0020962. Half-lives below are prototype estimates, not estimates reported by this study.

effortWeight.estimatedFrom: One-fifth normalized time cost; causal magnitude remains uncalibrated.
effortWeight.citation: BLS American Time Use Survey 2025, Table 1 and news release; https://www.bls.gov/news.release/atus.t01.htm and https://www.bls.gov/news.release/atus.nr0.htm

restEffect.estimatedFrom: Prototype recovery amount per available rest act; not a clinical estimate.
restEffect.citation: BLS American Time Use Survey 2025, Table 1 and news release; https://www.bls.gov/news.release/atus.t01.htm and https://www.bls.gov/news.release/atus.nr0.htm

contactEffect.estimatedFrom: Prototype change in company need per successful contact; no empirical causal size claimed.
contactEffect.citation: BLS American Time Use Survey 2025, Table 1 and news release; https://www.bls.gov/news.release/atus.t01.htm and https://www.bls.gov/news.release/atus.nr0.htm

careEffect.estimatedFrom: Prototype relief from a completed care task; does not cure illness.
careEffect.citation: BLS American Time Use Survey 2025, Table 1 and news release; https://www.bls.gov/news.release/atus.t01.htm and https://www.bls.gov/news.release/atus.nr0.htm

civicEffect.estimatedFrom: Prototype progress per completed civic act; records approach only and never assumes a policy win.
civicEffect.citation: 00s PACKAGES, P8 CORE, owner decision October 9, 2026.

companyHorizonDays.estimatedFrom: Prototype contact gap normalization; ATUS measures daily contact activity, not this decay constant.
companyHorizonDays.citation: BLS American Time Use Survey 2025, Table 1 and news release; https://www.bls.gov/news.release/atus.t01.htm and https://www.bls.gov/news.release/atus.nr0.htm

moneyBufferDays.estimatedFrom: One billing-cycle reserve against recorded living expenses; explicit opening estimate, not invented earned cash.
moneyBufferDays.citation: Existing game town-finances and monthly rent/pay records.

organizationReserveMonths.estimatedFrom: Prototype opening employer liquid reserve from recorded wages, not a measured balance sheet.
organizationReserveMonths.citation: Existing game town-business-books opening funds; missing exact capital is an estimate.

eventMoodImpulse.estimatedFrom: Prototype loss appraisal; raw event impact varies continuously with actor traits and relationship strength.
eventMoodImpulse.citation: Kuppens et al. (2010), Feelings change: accounting for individual differences in the temporal dynamics of affect, doi:10.1037/a0020962. Half-lives below are prototype estimates, not estimates reported by this study.

eventStressImpulse.estimatedFrom: Prototype loss appraisal; raw event impact varies continuously with actor traits and relationship strength.
eventStressImpulse.citation: Kuppens et al. (2010), Feelings change: accounting for individual differences in the temporal dynamics of affect, doi:10.1037/a0020962. Half-lives below are prototype estimates, not estimates reported by this study.

appraisalRelationshipWeight.estimatedFrom: Relationship continuity carries the full normalized event appraisal; explicit prototype assumption.
appraisalRelationshipWeight.citation: Kuppens et al. (2010), Feelings change: accounting for individual differences in the temporal dynamics of affect, doi:10.1037/a0020962. Half-lives below are prototype estimates, not estimates reported by this study.

appraisalDistressTraitWeight.estimatedFrom: Concern for distress changes event appraisal continuously; half-scale magnitude remains uncalibrated.

appraisalBroodingTraitWeight.estimatedFrom: Brooding changes ongoing appraisal continuously; half-scale magnitude remains uncalibrated.

emotionDurationMinHours.citation: Verduyn and Lavrijsen (2015), doi:10.1007/s11031-014-9445-y, Fig. 1; recalled emotion-duration medians in 233 Belgian high-school students. Not an adult US range or exponential half-life.

emotionDurationMaxHours.citation: Verduyn and Lavrijsen (2015), doi:10.1007/s11031-014-9445-y, Fig. 1; recalled emotion-duration medians in 233 Belgian high-school students. Not an adult US range or exponential half-life.

relationInitial.estimatedFrom: Generated household kinship starts with positive continuity, not a recorded personal feeling.
relationInitial.citation: Existing town-residents generated household relationship context.

relationContactGain.estimatedFrom: Prototype continuity reinforcement per successful reciprocal contact.
relationContactGain.citation: Existing game relationship interactions; no empirical causal magnitude claimed.

routineRetentionDays.citation: Owner October 8 result-only/weekly-compaction ruling and P8 STATE retention policy; durable visible records are exempt.

fallbackAnnualWageMinor.citation: BLS May 2021 OEWS national all-occupations row 00-0000: median hourly wage USD22.00; https://www.bls.gov/oes/2021/may/oes_nat.htm
fallbackAnnualWageMinor.estimatedFrom: USD22.00/hour times the OEWS2080-hour annual conversion in USD minor units. Proxy only for a job with no recorded local or same-occupation rate; not an observed January 2021 contract.

deepPastMiddleSchoolOffsetYears.estimatedFrom: Common K–5 / grades 6–8 / grades 9–12 stages used by existing school-calendar.ts; not a measured historical attendance date.

deepPastHighSchoolOffsetYears.estimatedFrom: Common K–5 / grades 6–8 / grades 9–12 stages used by existing school-calendar.ts; not a measured historical attendance date.
